subject: Copywriting
title: Push Notifications: The Tiny Headline
description: A quick, practical guide to Push Notifications: The Tiny Headline.

hook.text: A push notification has about 50 characters to convince you to open an app. It's the shortest headline format.

buildup.text: News apps, shopping apps, and social media all compete in the notification tray. One glance decides the click.

discovery.text: The best push notifications feel personal and urgent. 'Your order shipped' beats 'Check out our latest deals.'

twist.text: Bad notifications cause uninstalls. 60% of users disable push after too many irrelevant alerts. Headlines guard trust.

climax.text: A push notification is a headline with consequences. One bad one loses the reader permanently.

punchline.text: 50 characters, one chance. Push notifications are headlines.

quiz.question: What percentage of users disable push notifications when they're irrelevant?

details.summary: Push notifications are the smallest headlines in digital communication — typically under 50 characters, competing for attention on a locked phone screen. details.whyItMatters: Push notifications are the highest-urgency headlines most people encounter daily. Mastering this tiny format teaches extreme economy of language that benefits all headline writing.
takeaways: Push notifications must communicate value in under 50 characters
Personalized pushes achieve 4x higher engagement than generic ones
Poorly written pushes trigger notification disabling — permanent loss

faq.question: How do you write effective push notifications?
faq.answer: Front-load the most important word. Use the recipient's name or behavior when possible. Create urgency without manipulation. Every word must earn its place in the limited space. Test relentlessly — users who disable notifications are lost forever.

faq.question: What is the biggest risk of poor push notification copy?
faq.answer: Users disabling notifications entirely. Unlike email unsubscribes which still allow re-engagement, disabling push notifications severs the channel permanently. One irrelevant or annoying notification can cost you a subscriber's attention forever.
